The run reports 0/1,536 target misses in one seeded realization; standard SVD-PCA matched point estimates to 4.7e-16 on the same data. This is not a new PCA method or an established advantage.

limitations: The coverage proof is conditional on a fixed shared subspace and source-direction/noise independence; it is not an adaptive-source martingale result or an off-class guarantee. The model class is supplied, and the learner does not discover it.
The run is one seeded synthetic realization, not repeated-trial evidence or statistical significance. The reported float64 gates have no outward-rounded or machine-verified roundoff certificate.

SVD-PCA matches the proposed PCA point estimates on identical data and exposure; the run does not establish superiority over competent retaining controllers, Wiener/shrinkage, or total practical-cost alternatives.

Exact-arithmetic conjugate gradients solve the specified two-eigenvalue family in two exact actions; the result is about noisy target precision under the stated interface, not a general solver advantage.
The lower bound applies to its stated local range with q>=2; the q=1 sign-only case is excluded. There is no source-acquisition optimality or sharp finite-n claim.
The investment theorem requires a retained-refinement bias^2<=A/E contract that the actual uncurated source class does not supply; no worker-allocation law or realized competitiveness claim follows.

The independent internal audit reports are not all present and this intake did not repeat any theorem review or run scientific scripts. Physical validation, external usefulness, novelty and practical advantage remain UNKNOWN.
